persistence.mechanism: The manual toggle writes data-theme on <html> and localStorage; the blocking head script themeScript (lib/theme.ts) replays it before first paint, so a manual choice is remembered. prefers-color-scheme is never consulted; the toggle treats a missing data-theme as dark.

light.description: Warm paper under the same navy signs. The only override block; every token is defined on :root in its dark value.

display.purpose: The AiPulse name on the home sign only.

headline.purpose: Page titles on feed, archive, method and search.

room-number.purpose: The last-scan date in a 2px white plate on the home sign. Tabular numerals.

body.purpose: Summaries (max 64ch) and method prose (max 60ch), set in Assistant.

label.purpose: Family and category names, controls, legend entries; meta and tags at 0.75rem.

nav.purpose: Header directory, footer links, arrowed text links.

lines.name: lane
lines.value: 4px wide, 4px gap; 4 lanes (one per category) from 640px, the item lane only below
lines.purpose: Item rail at the inline start.

lines.name: line-solid
lines.purpose: Primary-source line, in the item's category colour.

lines.name: line-dashed
lines.purpose: Secondary-reporting line, in the item's category colour.

lines.name: title-branch
lines.value: 4px thick, from the lane edge to 6px short of the headline, top 0.62em
lines.purpose: Joins the item lane to its headline.

lines.name: rule-weights
lines.value: 1px hairline; 2px ink heavy rule; 3px focus ring and current-page bar; 4px navy section rule
lines.purpose: The only line weights in the system.

motion.name: wake
motion.value: scaleX 0 to 1, 0.9s, expo.out, stagger 0.09s, delay 0.15s, origin at the inline-start edge
motion.purpose: Strip lines switch on category after category on load.

motion.name: lane-draw
motion.value: ScrollTrigger.batch, start "top 92%", once; scaleY 0 to 1, 0.8s, expo.out, stagger 0.07s, origin top
motion.purpose: Each item lane draws as it enters.

motion.name: branch-draw
motion.purpose: The branch into the headline follows its lane.

motion.name: gate
motion.value: .motion-ok on <html>, set by the blocking motionScript only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference
motion.purpose: Lines start unpainted only under the gate; reduced motion renders everything static. Drawn lines carry data-drawn.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Hover and pressed colour changes on controls.

logo.description: The original AiPulse mark: a ring (the daily scan), a centre dot (the selected item) and a flagged dot off the ring (the item the reader flagged). viewBox 0 0 64 64. Always sits on the indigo top sign (#1a1544) in both themes, so its colours are fixed values rather than theme tokens. At rest on indigo: ivory 12.2:1, blue 6.6:1, yellow 11.8:1; ripples 3.5:1 or better.

geometry.ring: circle cx 30 cy 34 r 20.5, stroke-width 3.6, no fill

logo.icons: Rest state on a #1a1544 tile, rx 14/64, mark scaled 0.9 and centred: public/favicon.svg, app/icon.png (512), public/icons/icon-192.png, icon-512.png. app/apple-icon.png (180) is full-bleed; iOS masks it.

openItems: Headlines-only (compact) rows keep the full action row (pin, save, already-read, to-source).

bend.description: Each item's line bends off its lane into its headline: a 14px-radius quarter-turn (.title-bend; logical borders and one rounded corner so RTL mirrors it; dashed for secondary sources) plus a 4px run (.title-branch) stopping 6px short of the first letter. From 640px only; on a phone the run alone carries the line.
bend.motion: ScrollTrigger.batch, start 88%, once, batchMax 3, interval 0.15s. Per item: lane scaleY 0.7s expo.out; +0.22s bend opacity 0->1 and scale 0.3->1 from the lane corner, 0.3s power2.out; +0.36s run scaleX from the lane, 0.5s expo.out; items staggered 0.14s. Reduced motion: drawn static.

sequence.what: centre dot beats once: scale 1 -> 1.3 (0.125s power2.out) -> 1 (0.125s power2.in)
four ripples, one every 0.28s: r 6.8 -> 21 over 0.8s power1.out; opacity 0 -> 0.95 in 0.06s, then -> 0, 2px non-scaling stroke, in category lane order
ring stroke takes the ripple's colour, 0.15s
ring settles back to ivory #e8d9b5, 0.5s power1.inOut; it never rests on a category colour
flagged dot, hidden (scale 0) since t=0, pops in: scale 0 -> 1, 0.4s back.out(2.2)

logoMotion.triggers: once on load (0.35s delay); pointerenter and pointerdown replay; ignored while running; no loop
logoMotion.restState: the markup is the rest state; ripples ship at opacity 0. Static under reduced motion and without JavaScript. Under .motion-ok the flagged dot starts at opacity 0 until GSAP sets data-shown on it.
logoMotion.contrast: on indigo every ripple colour clears 3:1 (blue 5.2, green 5.1, red 3.5, yellow 11.8); the ring rests on ivory (12.2)

extensions.topEdge: Indigo is 1.09:1 against the dark floor, so the top area ends on a 1px sign-ink hairline at 25%: under the header sign, or under the home hero sign on the landing page (.header-sign drops its own there).

narrative.overview:
AiPulse is set as hospital floor wayfinding. The ground is the corridor at night (a deep navy-black floor), or warm paper in the light theme; the structure is navy enamel signage with white Hebrew; and every topic category is a coloured line painted on that floor. Floor lines lead to departments, and the departments here are the topic categories: R&D, health services, regulation, infrastructure. The digest is the corridor a clinician walks each morning: the sign tells you where you are and what day it is, the lines leave from under the sign, and each item stands on its own category's line. A colour on this site always means "this department", nothing else. What kind of source an item comes from is carried by the line's pattern (solid or dashed) and by text, never by colour.

The system is dense and sober. Headlines pack tightly down an unbroken rail, controls are square sign plates, and depth comes from the navy panels against the floor rather than from shadows. Dark is the default world (the corridor at night, signs lit); light is warm paper under the same navy signs, reached only by the manual toggle and remembered. The site refuses the dark card-grid news aggregator and the cream broadsheet.

There are two living elements: the floor lines paint themselves, and the logo beats on load and on hover or tap: its centre dot pulses once, four ripples in the category colours run out to the ring and tint it in turn, the ring settles back to ivory and the flagged dot pops in. On load the lines switch on category after category; on scroll each item's lane draws down its rail, then its line bends off the rail and runs into the headline. Nothing else moves, and with reduced motion nothing moves at all.
keyCharacteristics: Night-corridor floor (dark, default) or warm paper (light), navy enamel sign panels, white signage type.
Four category line colours, reserved exclusively for topic categories.
Primary source = solid line + filled dot; secondary reporting = dashed line + hollow dot.
One 4px line module governs lanes, gaps, strips, branches and heavy rules.
Rubik for signage (headings, numerals, controls); Assistant for reading.
Dark by default; the OS colour preference is never consulted; a manual choice is remembered.
One motion system (GSAP), transforms only, static under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Category Colour Rule
rules.body: A category colour is used for its topic category only: the item's lane, bend and run, the category swatch beside its name (item row, legend, filter), and the headline's hover underline. Never as a general accent, link colour, button fill or state colour, and never for a source family. Interactive state is navy.

rules.name: The Uncoloured Source Rule
rules.body: Source family is secondary information and carries no colour: its icon, the primary/secondary dot and its filter swatches are neutral ink. Source type reaches the reader through the line pattern on the coloured category line and through the family name as text.

rules.name: The Solid and Dashed Rule
rules.body: Primary sources are painted solid with a filled dot; secondary reporting is painted dashed (10px dash, 6px gap) with a hollow dot. The two encodings always travel together, and the screen-reader text says "מקור ראשוני" or "דיווח משני".

rules.name: The Dark Default Rule
rules.body: Dark is the default unconditionally, on every first visit. `prefers-color-scheme` is not read anywhere. Only the manual toggle changes the theme: it writes `data-theme` on `<html>` and persists it in localStorage under `aipulse:theme`, and a blocking head script (lib/theme.ts) replays it before first paint. With no `data-theme`, the toggle treats the current theme as dark.

rules.name: The Room Number Rule
rules.body: Every date and count is set in Rubik with tabular numerals and no wrapping (the `time` element and `.tnum`). Dates are ISO (2026-10-20) and bidi-isolated as LTR text.

rules.name: The Signage Face Rule
rules.body: Rubik carries anything a reader navigates by: headings, numerals, controls, labels. Assistant carries only what is read through.

rules.name: The Enamel Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: If something needs to stand forward, it becomes a navy sign plate or gains a heavier rule. It never gains a shadow.

rules.name: The 4px Module Rule
rules.body: One 4px module sets the lane width, lane gap, strip line height and gap, branch thickness and the heaviest rule. A new line-like element is 4px, or one of the existing rule weights (1px hairline, 2px heavy rule, 3px focus ring and current-page bar), never an arbitrary weight.

dos: **Do** set every item's `--line` from its category token (its first categorized topic) and paint its lane, bend, run, swatch and hover underline from that one variable.
**Do** pair solid line + filled dot for primary sources and dashed line + hollow dot for secondary reporting, with the matching screen-reader text.
**Do** use navy (sign) for every pressed, selected, pinned or boosted state.
**Do** keep corners at 0px and lines on the 4px module.
**Do** define every colour on `:root` in its dark value and override only in `:root[data-theme="light"]`.
**Do** set dates and counts in Rubik with tabular numerals, bidi-isolated.
**Do** animate only decorative lines, only with transforms, only under `.motion-ok`, and only through GSAP.
**Do** use logical properties exclusively, and keep touch targets at 44px on a phone.
donts: **Don't** use a category colour as a general accent, link, button or state colour, or to mark a source family.
**Don't** give a single topic its own colour; topics join a category.
**Don't** add shadows or rounded corners; the dot and the logo are the only circles, and the icon tile is the only rounded corner.
**Don't** let the logo ring rest on a category colour; it always settles to ivory.
**Don't** read `prefers-color-scheme` or make light the fallback.
**Don't** hide content behind motion or add a second animation library or effect.
**Don't** put `direction: ltr` on a positioned element; its `inset-inline-*` will flip.
**Don't** box items into cards; they stand on the floor, on their line.
**Don't** remove or soften the footer disclosure line.
